items.heading: "Forensic Science" Is Not One
items.text: "Forensic science" is not one career. It is an umbrella over eight specialisations that share a subject at school but split completely once you look at who actually hires, what degree they require, and what the job pays. Four of them, biology/DNA, toxicology, ballistics, and questioned documents, run almost entirely through government Forensic Science Laboratories on a fixed recruitment-exam ladder.

items.heading: Four of the Eight Tracks,
items.text: Four of the eight tracks, forensic biology/DNA and serology, toxicology, ballistics, and questioned documents, share the same employer type (state Forensic Science Laboratories and the Central Forensic Science Laboratory) and the same four-rung promotion ladder.
